title: Implemented MAKE_CONTACT request arguments
description: Object/group operands and contact termination. Omitted operands use the injected ScenePlan. Reference guards are internal policy, not Agent arguments.

object_id.description: Existing scene object ID; omission uses ScenePlan.object_id.

contact_groups.description: Prepared scene group IDs; omission uses ScenePlan.groups.

duration_s.description: Positive finite continuous contact interval in simulation seconds.

$comment: Describes arguments, not the tool envelope. Dynamic object/group availability is checked through the injected Adapter/ScenePlan. RFC 8259 JSON numbers are finite; runtime also rejects NaN/Infinity decoder extensions.
